title: Parentage judgment, acknowledgment, support order; social security number.
bodyText: The social security number of any individual who is subject to a parentage judgment or acknowledgment, or a support order issued under this chapter, shall be placed in the records relating to the matter in compliance with any other court rule or law.
bodyHtml: [§584A-511]  Parentage judgment, acknowledgment, support order; social security number.  The social security number of any individual who is subject to a parentage judgment or acknowledgment, or a support order issued under this chapter, shall be placed in the records relating to the matter in compliance with any other court rule or law. [L 2025, c 298, pt of §2]
